title: docs(pm): name the 3-hourly topic-board rebuild as a triage duty
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8JpuMUc83TvQP7B2uT2pUz5)_

Fixes #36740 — card item 4, the skill pointer. Items 1–3 (the script, the page template, the runbook) landed in #36757.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: yes
Ruling-ref: ruling record 7107018094 on #36740 — the maintainer, in the triage session, 2026-11-23: 「看板代码要放进仓库，立卡派发」; and on the seat's decision card, 2026-11-23 15:34Z: 「接，按普通顺序派」. Neither quote names this skill line; the link between the quotes and the card's item 4 (this line) is the seat's reading of card #36740, so the line itself waits for the maintainer's approval of this PR.

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：分诊座位的职责说明里加一行，写明每 3 小时照手册刷新专题看板。
- 属于车队工具：上一步已把看板脚本放进仓库，这一行让以后任何分诊座位都知道这是它的固定任务。
- 只改一行说明文字，不碰产品；写错了直接撤回这一行即可。
- 这是技能文本，需要 os-zhuang 批准后才能合并。

## What changes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md`: one new line naming the board duty — every 3 h, on the UTC hours 0, 3, …, 21, rebuild both repos' data and refresh the board following `scripts/pm/topic-board/README.md`. Placed with the other per-round duties, after the dropped-seat line.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `lanes/triage.md` ceiling rises 2526 → 2637, **+111 bytes**, the measured size of that one line. The file sat exactly at its ceiling, so the line cannot be paid by headroom. The raise cites ruling record **7107018094** (comment on #36740), in the PR body here and in the row's comment, as the ratchet discipline requires.

## Why

The card's item 4: the runbook landed in #36757, and the triage lane file is what a new triage seat reads first, so the duty has to be named there or a seat on another account would not know the board exists.

## Verification

Read first: the one added line in `lanes/triage.md`, then the CEILINGS row for it.

Two-minute check: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` → the `lanes/triage.md` line reads 2637 bytes, ceiling 2637.
